articles.title: Why It's Getting Harder for Some American Women to Find a Husband
articles.summary: Imagine a game of musical chairs where there aren't enough chairs. That's what the marriage market is like for some women, says a new study. Because fewer men have college degrees and good jobs, college-educated women are 'marrying down,' leaving non-college women with fewer options.

articles.title: A Tiny African Region Plans to Open an Embassy in Jerusalem—And It's Causing a Big Stir
articles.summary: Somaliland, a breakaway part of Somalia that no other country recognizes, says it will open an embassy in Jerusalem. Israel, which recognized Somaliland last year, will also open an office there. This is a big deal because Jerusalem is a disputed city at the heart of a long conflict.

articles.title: Trump Picks a Side in Texas: He Wants Ken Paxton to Beat Senator Cornyn
articles.summary: President Trump endorsed Ken Paxton for Senate, shaking up the Texas Republican primary. Paxton is trying to unseat longtime Senator John Cornyn. Trump called Paxton a 'true MAGA Warrior,' but some Republicans worry Paxton could lose the general election to a Democrat.
